relationships.evidence_quote: Taken together, these results from FR, PPR, and sEPSC analysis indicate a presynaptic enhancement of synaptic transmission from NRNav1.8 to the L1-STTN after SNI.

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: In SNI mice, the robust increase in pERK-IR signal in the DH was associated with a small but significant increase in the percentage of L1-STTNs showing pERK-IR (16.3 ± 1.4%, p = 0.0045, unpaired t test; Fig. 5B–D).

key_findings: SNI enhances transmission from Nav1.8 nociceptors onto lamina I spinothalamic neurons via presynaptic mechanisms (lower failure rate and paired-pulse ratio, higher sEPSC frequency)
No postsynaptic change (AMPA/NMDA ratio, unitary EPSC amplitude unchanged) and only a small rise in pERK-positive L1-STTNs
